multi-cli-cockpit.display:name: Multi-CLI Cockpit (Ultimate)
multi-cli-cockpit.description: 3 CLI agents (Claude Code, Gemini, Codex) + 2 GPU workers (RTX5090, RTX3090Ti) with Letta-MCP memory bridge

blocks.name: [CLAUDE] claude-code
blocks.cmd: export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/v1; export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=llxprt_ghost; export MCP_STDIO='letta,composio'; claude --enable-mcp

blocks.name: [GEMINI] gemini-cli
blocks.cmd: export GEMINI_API_BASE=http://localhost:8080/v1; export GEMINI_API_KEY=llxprt_ghost; export MCP_STDIO='letta,composio'; gemini --mcp letta,composio

blocks.name: [CODEX] codex-cli
blocks.cmd: export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/v1; export OPENAI_API_KEY=llxprt_ghost; export MCP_STDIO='letta,composio'; codex --mcp letta,composio

blocks.name: [GPU] RTX-5090 (DeepSeek)
blocks.cmd: ssh -t worker-rtx5090-win 'echo ===RTX5090===; watch -n1 nvidia-smi; docker logs -f worker-5090-vllm' || bash

blocks.name: [GPU] RTX-3090Ti (Llama)
blocks.cmd: ssh -t worker-rtx3090ti-win 'echo ===RTX3090Ti===; watch -n1 nvidia-smi; docker logs -f worker-3090-vllm' || bash

daemon-dashboard.display:name: Daemon Dashboard (Ghost Layer)
daemon-dashboard.description: Real-time monitoring of llxprt-jefe, llxprt-code proxy, and Letta-MCP server

cluster-monitor.display:name: Cluster Health Monitor
cluster-monitor.description: Live orchestrator, oracle-vps, and GPU worker cluster status

blocks.name: Orchestrator (localhost)
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; echo '=== ORCHESTRATOR STACK ==='; docker ps --filter 'status=running' --format 'table {{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Ports}}' | head -20; sleep 5; done

blocks.name: Oracle-VPS (Cloud)
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; echo '=== ORACLE-VPS ==='; docker --context oracle compose -f infra/hosts/oracle-vps/docker-compose.yml ps --filter 'status=running' --format 'table {{.Service}}	{{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null | head -15; sleep 5; done

blocks.name: GPU Workers Mesh
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; echo '=== GPU WORKERS ==='; for ctx in worker-rtx5090 worker-rtx3090ti worker-rtx3060; do echo "[$ctx]"; docker --context $ctx ps -q | wc -l | xargs -I {} echo "  {} containers running"; done; sleep 5; done

blocks.name: Nexus Router (Port 6000)
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; echo '=== NEXUS ROUTER ==='; curl -s http://localhost:6000/health 2>/dev/null | jq . || echo 'Router offline'; sleep 5; done

daemon-logs.display:name: Daemon Logs (Tail All)
daemon-logs.description: Aggregated tail of all 3 daemon processes with split view

name: 3-worker-openclaw-topology
description: OpenClaw status + NerveUI for all 3 workers (inference + cron)

panes.title: NerveUI Cron Interface (RTX3060)
panes.cmd: curl -s http://worker-rtx3060:6008/cron 2>/dev/null || echo 'Connecting to Cron Interface...'
